title: Figure Reading
description: Pass-2 structured figure reading of a read paper. For each figure that carries weight: its axes, the controls and error bars present (or honestly null when absent), the single take-home, and what to distrust about it. source_ref-anchored; rendered into the DB paper page. A reading aid — never a governed gate.

source_ref.description: the paper these figures come from (matches the paper_note / DB page source_ref)

figures.description: one entry per read figure; figure_ref + take_home are the minimum a figure reading must carry

axes.description: what the x/y axes (or rows/columns) actually measure

controls.description: the controls / ablations / baselines present in the figure, or null when none are shown

error_bars.description: the error bars / variance / confidence shown, or null when the figure reports point estimates with no spread

take_home.description: the single thing this figure is meant to convince you of

distrust.description: what to be skeptical of in this figure: cherry-picked example, truncated axis, missing baseline, no variance, or null when nothing stands out
